transcription.notes: Numeric groups 1-1647; hyphens join groups into words; ends 'Duplicata'.

system.summary: Numeric code of about 1,650 groups, with hyphenated syllable compounds; flat distribution (463 types in 901 tokens).
system.notes: Ends 'Duplicata'; companion f. 3 (R8871) is an unrelated trigram code.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Used R8870 images downloaded in the r8871 session.
463 distinct, 257 hapax, max 1647: flat large code.
Tested R8890 (French 6001+) and R8894-R8919 (Dutch 1823-42) by range and Principal frequency lists.

outcome.notes: Needs the key or a decipherment; ciphertext-only rebuild not feasible at 901 tokens.
